audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-19 BOX CLOSING ROUND - the pure flip, no new ink. Both report-019 boxes flip at this single round: the issue-19 opener chains part one (the R937 wish-spell doctrine, the mythos of Australia pantheon, the systematic magic fields) and part two (the R938 Origins 78 tourney and victory-point scoring, the creative treasures and location/trap/gas charts, the hostile magic-user spell determination grids). Six chains across three rounds, the third three-round issue shape after 17 and 18. The bookkeeping mirrors the f17 and f18 closers: the boxes, chains and rounds consts, the issue-closed consts 7 through 18, the walk-complete bools and the unchanged registry ground truth.

banner.title: The Dragon issue-19 box closing round - the six-chain walk complete, issues 2 through 19 all closed
banner.provenance: The pure flip of the issue-19 three-round shape - no new ink pinned, both report-019 boxes closed. The issue-19 openers stand at R937 (dws: the wish-spell doctrine, the mythos of Australia, the systematic magic fields) and R938 (sdm: the Origins 78 tourney and scoring, the treasure chains, the spell determination grids), all pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 5 (October 1978), the Curtiss-provided Dm19.pdf scan voice.
banner.sentinel: No new print catches at this flip - the issue-19 print quirks all rode the two opener records: the doubled Gate, the Champion 7th Wawalag line, the Mimi armor class 8, the Smurre continuation stamp, the Kuo-Tao spelling cross, the unassigned 14-15 location bands, the -01-05 leading dash and the dungeons-only asterisks. Both inherited watches - the Sullin levels 7-9 and the brawling sequel - stayed empty through issue 19 and ride to TD 20.
